name: Tenki Ane
source:
Junichi has two older sisters, Miu and Yuu. They are popular weather forecasters. His friends envy him, but they aren't actually good sisters at home! However, Miu and Yuu have taken good care of him since their parents passed away when they were kids. Therefore, Junichi can't talk back to them...

[From ErogeShop]
